validity.researcher_notes: The pipeline is real and operating per Gazprom's own page. Gazprom runs it through several regional subsidiaries, so a single operator name is a simplification.

fills.researcher_notes: Gazprom's project page (Russian, Wayback capture of Dec 2021) says the pipeline is 2,200 km long. The English page (capture of May 2019) gives the same figure. Both are Gazprom's own pages, so they count as one publisher.

verifications.note: Page of the Vuktyl linear production department, a branch of Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta, says the branch operates the lines including SRTO - Torzhok (СРТО — Торжок). Read as a Wayback copy of the live ukhta-tr.gazprom.ru page.

fills.researcher_notes: A Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta branch page lists the SRTO to Torzhok line among the lines the Vuktyl branch operates. The page does not give a length for this line, only 720.32 km of single-string pipe for all lines of the branch. Operator is the operating subsidiary, Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta LLC. One source, so medium.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Gazprom's own project page (Dec 2021 capture) lists SRTO to Torzhok among its operating trunklines with 13 compressor stations. The May 2019 fire on the related SRTO to Ural line did not close this one. No newer dated item among the citations.
